response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced software craftsman with a strong background in distributed systems, testing, and recent exposure to AI tooling. However, for a Principal (IC6) role specifically focused on Growth and Experimentation Systems, his resume lacks the necessary domain expertise. There is no demonstrated experience in designing enterprise experimentation frameworks, feature flighting, telemetry foundations, or the statistical analysis required for this highly specialized position.
strengths: Extensive software engineering experience (15+ years) across diverse tech stacks, including TypeScript, Node.js, C/C++, and DLang.
Proven ability to build and scale high-throughput systems, evidenced by handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby.
Recent hands-on experience building AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (MCP code generators).
concerns: Complete lack of demonstrated experience building or managing enterprise-scale experimentation, A/B testing, or growth measurement platforms.
No visible background in statistical methods, data analysis, or bias detection required for the core responsibilities of this role.

While he holds Staff titles, his leadership experience is primarily in smaller or mid-sized companies, which may not translate to the cross-organizational influence required of an IC6 at enterprise scale.
